hints.title: Mandatory Assignments for 2 and 0
hints.text: Columns with sum 2 must assign 1 to both rows, and columns with sum 0 must assign 0 to both rows.

hints.title: Greedy Allocation for Sum 1 Columns
hints.text: For columns with sum 1, assign 1 to the row that currently has a larger remaining quota.

hints.title: Validate Final Quotas
hints.text: If either upper or lower becomes negative or finishes non-zero, no valid binary matrix exists; return empty.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all binary assignments across columns takes 2^N combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy placement resolves mandatory slots first then balances remaining slots in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check that upper and lower quotas match exactly at completion.
complexity.notes: Returns empty list when constraints cannot be satisfied.
